summary.text: Matt MacPherson is a Republican state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 26 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Utah Republican delegation appointed him to the seat in October 2023, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as business.

paragraphs.text: Matt MacPherson was born in Las Vegas, Nevada.
Ballotpedia reports that a Utah Republican delegation appointed him on October 4, 2023 to replace Quinn Kotter, and that he was sworn in on October 10, 2023.
His career experience includes working as a business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, MacPherson said he moved to Utah from Las Vegas in 2004, has built several companies, and has raised three children in Utah with his wife of 24 years.
He described his priorities as parental rights, individual freedoms, free markets and small government, and said he has voted to cut taxes and against new taxes.
He listed transparency, accountability, shrinking government and criminal justice as policy areas he cares about.
